extra_vocab.en: a person who starts a new business
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於商業新聞、創業與投資情境，指自己創辦事業並承擔風險的人。語氣正面，常和 start-up、investor 一起出現。

example.en: Many young entrepreneurs attended the business fair last week.
example.zh: 許多年輕的創業者參加了上週的商展。

example.en: The bank offers special loans to every young entrepreneur.
example.zh: 這家銀行為每位年輕創業者提供特別貸款。

example.en: She became a successful entrepreneur before the age of thirty.
example.zh: 她在三十歲前就成為成功的企業家。

example.en: A local entrepreneur donated money to the new library.
example.zh: 一位當地企業家捐款給新圖書館。

examples.en: The entrepreneur opened her second coffee shop this spring.
examples.zh: 這位創業者今年春天開了第二家咖啡店。

examples.en: The guest speaker is a well-known entrepreneur in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 這位來賓講者是科技業知名的企業家。

examples.en: Investors met with the entrepreneur to discuss the business plan.
examples.zh: 投資人和這位創業者見面討論營運計畫。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近；enterprise 是「企業、事業」，entrepreneur 是創辦事業的「人」。

example.en: The enterprise employs more than two hundred workers.
example.zh: 這家企業雇用了兩百多名員工。

similar.diff: founder 強調「創立者」；entrepreneur 強調敢冒險開創事業。

example.en: The founder of the company still attends every meeting.
example.zh: 這家公司的創辦人仍然參加每一場會議。

similar.diff: business owner 是「事業的老闆」，不一定是創業的人。

example.en: Each business owner must renew the license every year.
example.zh: 每位店主每年都必須更新執照。

example.en: An investor asked to see our sales report.
example.zh: 一位投資人要求看我們的銷售報告。

example.en: The founder gave a short speech at the party.
example.zh: 創辦人在派對上做了簡短的演說。

example.en: The owner of the shop is on vacation.
example.zh: 這家店的老闆正在度假。

derived.link: entrepreneur + -ship，表示身分或精神，像 friendship、leadership

extra_vocab.en: a moving stair that carries people up or down
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物中心、機場與地鐵站的廣播與公告，例如 Please hold the handrail on the escalator、The escalator is out of order。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在手扶梯上」用 on the escalator；「搭手扶梯」用 take 或 ride the escalator。

example.en: Both escalators near the entrance will be closed for repair.
example.zh: 入口附近的兩座手扶梯將關閉維修。

example.en: Take the escalator to the third floor for men's clothing.
example.zh: 男裝請搭手扶梯到三樓。

example.en: The escalator is out of order, so please use the stairs.
example.zh: 手扶梯故障了，請改走樓梯。

example.en: Please hold the handrail while you are on the escalator.
example.zh: 在手扶梯上請握緊扶手。

examples.en: The escalator at the mall leads straight to the food court.
examples.zh: 購物中心的手扶梯直接通往美食街。

examples.en: Passengers with heavy bags should use the elevator, not the escalator.
examples.zh: 帶著重行李的乘客應搭電梯，不要搭手扶梯。

examples.en: Workers will repair the escalator between ten and noon.
examples.zh: 工人將在十點到中午之間維修手扶梯。

confusable.diff: elevator 是「電梯」（箱型）；escalator 是會移動的「手扶梯」。

example.en: The elevator is faster than the stairs for the tenth floor.
example.zh: 到十樓時，電梯比樓梯快。

example.en: Please wait for the elevator on the first floor.
example.zh: 請在一樓等電梯。

example.en: The stairs are next to the emergency exit.
example.zh: 樓梯在緊急出口旁邊。

example.en: Our guests are waiting for you in the lobby.
example.zh: 我們的客人正在大廳等你。

derived.link: escalate 像「一階一階往上」；escalator 加 -or 變成「會往上走的機器」，像 elevator
escalate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

extra_vocab.en: to move people out of a place because it is not safe
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於火災、颱風、地震等緊急公告與安全演習，語氣正式。常聽到 Please evacuate the building immediately。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: evacuate 的受詞可以是「人」或「地方」：evacuate residents（疏散居民）、evacuate the building（撤離大樓）。

example.en: The school evacuates all students when the fire alarm rings.
example.zh: 火警鈴一響，學校就疏散所有學生。

example.en: Staff evacuated the office within five minutes of the alarm.
example.zh: 警報響起後五分鐘內，員工就撤離了辦公室。

example.en: Security guards are evacuating the second floor right now.
example.zh: 保全人員現在正在疏散二樓。

example.en: Please evacuate the building through the nearest exit.
example.zh: 請從最近的出口撤離大樓。

example.en: The city decided to evacuate residents before the typhoon arrived.
example.zh: 市政府決定在颱風來臨前疏散居民。

example.en: Hundreds of guests were evacuated from the hotel last night.
example.zh: 昨晚數百名房客從飯店被疏散。

examples.en: Everyone must evacuate calmly when the fire alarm sounds.
examples.zh: 火警響起時，每個人都必須冷靜撤離。

examples.en: Officials told people near the river to evacuate at once.
examples.zh: 官員要求靠近河邊的人立刻撤離。

examples.en: We will practice how to evacuate the office on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們星期五會演練如何撤離辦公室。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近；vacate 是「空出」房間或位子，不一定因為危險。

example.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon on checkout day.
example.zh: 退房當天，房客必須在中午前空出房間。

similar.diff: clear the building 較口語，指請大家都離開大樓。

example.en: Security asked us to clear the building quickly.
example.zh: 保全要求我們快速離開大樓。

example.en: In an emergency, call the front desk first.
example.zh: 遇到緊急狀況時，請先打電話給櫃檯。

example.en: The emergency exit is at the end of the hall.
example.zh: 緊急出口在走廊盡頭。

example.en: We have a fire drill every six months.
example.zh: 我們每六個月做一次防火演習。

derived.link: evacuate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education
evacuate + -ee，被…的人，像 employee（被雇用的人）

extra_vocab.en: a short trip that people take together for fun
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊與公司活動情境，指一天或半天的團體出遊，如 a day excursion、an optional excursion。

example.en: The hotel offers several excursions to nearby islands each week.
example.zh: 飯店每週提供數個前往附近島嶼的出遊行程。

example.en: We booked a day excursion to the mountains for the team.
example.zh: 我們為團隊預訂了前往山區的一日遊。

example.en: Staff will go on an excursion after the training ends.
example.zh: 訓練結束後，員工將去出遊。

example.en: The boat ride is an optional excursion with a small fee.
example.zh: 這趟遊船是需另付小額費用的自費行程。

examples.en: The company planned a one-day excursion to the seaside.
examples.zh: 公司安排了前往海邊的一日出遊。

examples.en: After the conference, we joined an excursion to the old town.
examples.zh: 會議結束後，我們參加了前往老城區的出遊。

examples.en: Please sign up for the excursion at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請在櫃檯報名這個出遊行程。

similar.diff: trip 是最一般的「旅行」，長短都可以；excursion 多指短程的團體出遊。

example.en: Our business trip to Tokyo lasts four days.
example.zh: 我們前往東京的出差為期四天。

similar.diff: outing 較口語，指短暫的休閒外出，如公司聚餐或野餐。

example.en: The annual outing will be held at the lake.
example.zh: 年度出遊將在湖邊舉行。

example.en: The trip to the factory takes two hours.
example.zh: 到工廠的路程要兩個小時。

example.en: The guide will lead a tour of the museum.
example.zh: 導遊會帶領參觀博物館。

example.en: I will send you the itinerary by email.
example.zh: 我會用電子郵件把行程表寄給你。

extra_vocab.en: giving reasons or information to make something clear
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於說明書、公告與表格，如 an explanatory note（說明附註）。另一個常見用法是 self-explanatory，表示「不用多說就看得懂」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: self-explanatory 的意思是「不用解釋就明白」，是形容詞，常放在 be 動詞後面：The form is self-explanatory。

example.en: Please read the explanatory note at the bottom of the form.
example.zh: 請閱讀表格底部的說明附註。

example.en: Each chart comes with a short explanatory text.
example.zh: 每張圖表都附有一小段說明文字。

example.en: The instructions are self-explanatory, so training is not needed.
example.zh: 這些說明一看就懂，所以不需要訓練。

examples.en: The manual includes an explanatory section about safety rules.
examples.zh: 說明書裡有一個關於安全規定的說明章節。

examples.en: She added explanatory notes to every slide in the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報的每張投影片都加上說明附註。

examples.en: An explanatory leaflet is attached to the package.
examples.zh: 包裹裡附有一份說明小冊子。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近；exploratory 是「探索性的」，指初步調查。

example.en: We held an exploratory meeting before starting the project.
example.zh: 專案開始前，我們先開了一場初步探討的會議。

similar.diff: informative 強調「資訊豐富、有用」；explanatory 強調「把事情解釋清楚」。

example.en: The informative brochure describes each service in detail.
example.zh: 這本資訊豐富的小冊子詳細介紹每項服務。

example.en: Please explain how the new system works.
example.zh: 請解釋新系統如何運作。

example.en: Follow the instructions on the back of the box.
example.zh: 請依照盒子背面的說明操作。

derived.link: explain 是詞幹動詞，explanatory 是它的形容詞（說明的）
explain 變名詞時拼法略變成 explan- + -ation，像 inform → information

extra_vocab.en: from or like a faraway country, and interesting because it is different
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、餐飲與進口商品情境，語氣正面，表示「來自遠方、很特別」，如 exotic fruit、exotic destination。

example.en: The travel agency promotes exotic destinations to young couples.
example.zh: 旅行社向年輕情侶推廣異國旅遊地點。

example.en: The restaurant is known for its exotic food from Asia.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以來自亞洲的異國料理聞名。

example.en: We import exotic fruit from Thailand and the Philippines.
example.zh: 我們從泰國和菲律賓進口特色水果。

examples.en: Bali is an exotic place for a company holiday.
examples.zh: 峇里島是適合公司旅遊的異國風情地點。

examples.en: The menu offers many exotic dishes you cannot find elsewhere.
examples.zh: 菜單上有許多別處吃不到的異國料理。

examples.en: Exotic flowers arrive at the airport every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 異國花卉每週一早上抵達機場。

similar.diff: foreign 只是「外國的」，語氣中性；exotic 還帶有「特別、有魅力」的感覺。

example.en: We hired a foreign engineer for the new project.
example.zh: 我們為新專案聘請了一位外籍工程師。

similar.diff: unusual 是「不尋常的」，不一定來自國外；exotic 強調異國來源。

example.en: The shop sells unusual gifts for business partners.
example.zh: 這家店販售適合商業夥伴的特別禮物。

example.en: Foreign visitors can buy tickets at the main gate.
example.zh: 外國遊客可在正門購票。

example.en: It is unusual for the store to close early.
example.zh: 這家店提早打烊是很少見的。

example.en: The hotel is surrounded by a large tropical garden.
example.zh: 這間飯店被一座大型熱帶花園環繞。

extra_vocab.en: the quality of being very good
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司理念、廣告與頒獎情境，語氣正式正面，如 commitment to excellence、award for excellence。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: excellence 是不可數名詞，不加 s；表示「某方面的卓越」用 excellence in + 領域。

example.en: Our team won an award for excellence in customer service.
example.zh: 我們的團隊獲得客戶服務卓越獎。

example.en: The company has a strong commitment to excellence in every product.
example.zh: 這家公司對每項產品的卓越品質都有堅定的承諾。

example.en: We strive for excellence in everything we do for clients.
example.zh: 我們為客戶做的每件事都追求卓越。

examples.en: Excellence is one of the main values of our company.
examples.zh: 卓越是我們公司的主要價值之一。

examples.en: She was honored for her excellence in teaching and training.
examples.zh: 她因教學與訓練上的卓越表現而受到表揚。

examples.en: The hotel is famous for its excellence in service.
examples.zh: 這家飯店以服務卓越聞名。

confusable.diff: excellent 是形容詞（優秀的）；excellence 是名詞（卓越）。
confusable.usage: excellent 放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（an excellent report）；excellence 當名詞，不加 s。

example.en: Your presentation was excellent, and the client was impressed.
example.zh: 你的簡報很優秀，客戶印象深刻。

similar.diff: quality 是中性的「品質」，可好可壞；excellence 一定是「很好」。

example.en: Quality matters more than speed in this project.
example.zh: 在這個專案中，品質比速度重要。

example.en: The quality of our service has improved this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的服務品質有所提升。

example.en: All products must meet our safety standards.
example.zh: 所有產品都必須符合我們的安全標準。

example.en: Finishing the project early was a great achievement.
example.zh: 提早完成專案是一項很棒的成就。

derived.link: excel 是詞幹動詞，「超越別人」；excellence = excel + -ence，變名詞，像 differ → difference

extra_vocab.en: to give a person or place the things needed for a job
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室、工廠、飯店設備的介紹，多用被動 be equipped with，語氣正式。也可指「使具備能力」，如 equip staff with new skills。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: equip 的句型是 equip + 人／地點 + with + 設備，常用被動 be equipped with；不要寫成 equip with 設備 而漏掉受詞。

example.en: The company equips every new employee with a laptop.
example.zh: 公司為每位新進員工配備一台筆電。

example.en: The hotel equipped each room with a coffee maker.
example.zh: 飯店在每間客房都配備了咖啡機。

example.en: We are equipping the new lab with modern machines.
example.zh: 我們正在為新實驗室配備現代化機器。

example.en: Every meeting room is equipped with a large screen.
example.zh: 每間會議室都配有大型螢幕。

example.en: The apartment has a fully equipped kitchen for long stays.
example.zh: 這間公寓有適合長期居住、設備齊全的廚房。

example.en: The gym is clean and well-equipped for all guests.
example.zh: 這間健身房乾淨，且為所有房客備有良好的設備。

examples.en: We need to equip the new office with desks and chairs.
examples.zh: 我們需要為新辦公室配備桌椅。

examples.en: The course will equip staff with useful sales skills.
examples.zh: 這門課程將讓員工具備實用的銷售技巧。

examples.en: The factory plans to equip its trucks with new safety systems.
examples.zh: 工廠打算為貨車配備新的安全系統。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音接近；equal 是「相等的、平等的」。

example.en: All employees have equal access to the training room.
example.zh: 所有員工都有平等使用訓練室的權利。

similar.diff: supply A with B 是「供應」物品，重點在提供；equip 強調「配齊工作所需的設備」。

example.en: We supply every new employee with a laptop and phone.
example.zh: 我們為每位新進員工提供筆電和手機。

similar.diff: provide A with B 比 equip 更一般，什麼東西都可以提供。

example.en: The hotel provides guests with free breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上為房客提供免費早餐。

example.en: The office equipment was delivered this morning.
example.zh: 辦公室設備今天早上送到了。

example.en: This software is a useful tool for planning.
example.zh: 這套軟體是很實用的規劃工具。

example.en: Please turn off your mobile device during the meeting.
example.zh: 開會時請關掉你的行動裝置。

derived.link: equip + -ment，動詞變名詞，像 pay → payment；equipment 是不可數，不加 s
